name: Setup stage heading
does: Document title.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Interview then write config
does: Interview the user and write .claude/mise-config.md per references/config-reference.md.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a config the rest of the workflow cannot read)
costNote: 12 interview items at 1-3 questions per turn: 4-12 user turns

name: Read reference, never copy
does: Read config-reference.md first and never copy it into the project.
preventsClaim: the reference doc leaking into the user's repo
costNote: 1 extra file read (config-reference.md, 1 of 2 reference files)

name: Revisit existing config sectionwise
does: An existing config is revisited section by section, showing the current value and offering to keep it.
preventsClaim: a re-run silently discarding recorded settings
costNote: re-interviews all 12 items on every `setup` invocation

name: Interview heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Ask in small batches
does: Ask the interview in small batches using interaction.md's question format.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Infer suggestions from repo
does: Infer suggested answers from package.json scripts, test directories, UI framework.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: asking what the repo already shows)

name: Point at existing guide docs
does: Where a guide doc or project skill already covers a section, offer a pointer to it as the default.
preventsClaim: duplicating project documentation inside the config

name: Skipped items write nothing
does: Except the required values and the checklist, a skipped item writes no section or line.
preventsClaim: empty placeholder sections in the generated config

name: Required config values
does: Collect mise directory, branch convention, and Format/Check/Unit tests commands.
preventsClaim: unstated (these are exactly what the config gate blocks on)
costNote: 1 git branch call for the convention inference

name: Optional scoped task tests
does: Collect an optional Task tests command with a `<path>` placeholder.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Checklist path and creation
does: Collect the review checklist path and create the starter file when missing.
preventsClaim: a Checklist: value naming a file that does not exist

name: Starter checklist block open
does: Opens the fenced starter-checklist template and its title.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Answer every rule explicitly
does: Checklist instructs its reader to answer every rule pass/fail/n-a against the diff before committing.
preventsClaim: a reviewer skimming rather than answering the checklist
costNote: consumed by the reviewer/implementer roles, not the driver

name: Code section heading
does: Checklist section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No leftover debug code
does: Checklist rule 1: grep the diff for print/console/debugger and commented-out code.
preventsClaim: debug statements and commented-out code shipping

name: New files have tests
does: Checklist rule 2: every new file has a colocated test or a cited Test exception.
preventsClaim: untested new files

name: No REQ identifiers in code
does: Checklist rule 3: grep the diff for REQ-* identifiers in code, comments, tests, strings.
preventsClaim: workflow identifiers leaking into shipped source

name: Nothing changed outside task
does: Checklist rule 4: compare the diff's file list against the task's Files to modify/create.
preventsClaim: scope creep outside the task's declared files

name: Changed behavior has failing test
does: Checklist rule 5: changed behavior has a test that fails without the change; name it.
preventsClaim: tests that pass with or without the change

name: Prose section heading
does: Checklist section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Comments explain why
does: Checklist rule 6: every comment explains why or a non-obvious what; none restates the code.
preventsClaim: comments that restate the code
costNote: the only prose-quality rule in the starter checklist

name: Checklist block close
does: Closes the fenced template.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Checklist is user-owned
does: Tell the user the checklist is theirs: one rule per line, Code then Prose, at most 15, retrospective proposes edits.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: an unbounded or unparseable checklist)
costNote: cap of 15 rules bounds per-task review cost

name: Mock conditions and guidance
does: UI projects only: collect Mock conditions and, given any, Mock guidance.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Test conventions
does: Collect the project's Test conventions.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Test exceptions with substitutes
does: Collect work that gets no regression test, each with its substitute verification; suggest two defaults.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: demanding tests where none are possible)

name: Skills and guides entries
does: Collect skills and guide docs agents should use, including e2e runner, screenshot, design/voice/domain guides.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: drives per-task Guides sections and gate e2e runs

name: Database migration command
does: Collect the migration generation command, if any.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Backlog source
does: Capture how to fetch the top items from an external tracker, as freeform prose.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Review notes source
does: Capture how to read the branch's notes from an external diff-review tool.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: no assigned file consumes this value

name: Per-role model assignments
does: Ask which of seven roles run off the session model; documenter is asked separately and also switches passes.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: paying session-model cost for every subagent)
costNote: the documenter answer decides two-pass mode, which adds one subagent per code commit

name: Retrospective on by default
does: Retrospective is on by default; write `Retrospective: off` only on a no.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Ship mode
does: Collect Ship: pr, merge (with style), or off.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: being asked at close-out)

name: Code conventions go elsewhere
does: Code conventions the user offers belong in CLAUDE.md, not the config; offer to add them.
preventsClaim: the config growing into a coding-standards document

name: Write and verify heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Write config, print, confirm
does: Write the config with only the filled sections, print it, and confirm it looks right.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a wrong config driving every later run)
costNote: 1 user turn; whole config echoed into the transcript

name: Install CLAUDE.md shipping guard
does: Ensure CLAUDE.md carries the shipping guard, creating it or updating a previous guard line.
preventsClaim: a second guard line accumulating on re-setup

name: Guard text blocks in-flight PRs
does: The guard forbids PRs or merges from any branch whose tree still contains the mise directory.
preventsClaim: shipping a branch whose workflow artifacts are still present
costNote: loaded into every session in that project via CLAUDE.md

name: Commit setup artifacts together
does: Commit config, checklist file, and guard together as `mise: setup`.
preventsClaim: unstated
